scope: Generic external-device rail routing at native World analog boundaries; no native FC cold-power acceptance.
asserted_behavior: Declared exact device and rail route resolution; no implicit registration.
All voltage values validated before any device power mutation.
Time-zero rails applied before CPU instructions.
Two-rail swaps do not create intermediate gate generations.
Separate node IDs retain independent sensor power states.
Off SPI transfers return parked response; model time does not advance.
CPU and shared MNA time continue while the off sensor clock remains parked.
limitations: Tiny Cortex-M loops, not actual native FC firmware.
Operating availability and reset model, no current/inrush/damage model.
No sensor motion or accuracy qualification.
normal_gates: The normal commit and push hooks run after these recorded focused checks; their results are recorded separately.
